Now its bland, boring, and full of Ai? reviews.title: Too much AI :(
reviews.text: I really wanted to like this browser, I’ve used it for about a year now. The problem I keep running into is that it’s absolutely FULL of AI everywhere, you can’t avoid it or turn it off. The images feature is completely full of slop, it’s very difficult to find real normal photos of things. It’s disappointing considering AI is destroying the planet, making the integration of this counterintuitive to the mission. I know the AI is to “keep up” with the other popular search browsers, but I really think most people who are looking for browser alternatives are not interested in AI. If this is removed, or at least if there’s an option to remove it like DuckDuckGo, then I might come back. But right now it feels practically unusable to me </3

reviews.title: I want to like this app
reviews.text: What sane person doesn’t like the idea of funding forest restoration with every search? The trouble is the app has so many bugs and problems that it’s virtually unusable. For example, the search bar doesn’t work after I’ve done a search. Sometimes I’ll search for something and then when I see the results, I realize I need to change the wording on the search but I can’t just click on the search bar to add or change a word. I have to go back to the previous page and re-enter the search from scratch. This was annoying but tolerable. Now I can’t do any searches at all. Every time I do a search, I get a captcha page asking me to prove that I’m not a robot and no matter how many times I click the little box, that page just reloads over and over again. How can I fund reforestation if I can’t use the function that is supposed to do that? Add to these things the security issues and it’s not worth it. It’s a great concept but if the app doesn’t function, what’s the point?

reviews.title: Great idea, not great in practice
reviews.text: I want to love this app because it genuinely seems great for the environment but the unfortunate reality is it just doesn’t work the same as Google. Your search results will be completely different. It’s not streamlined to be able to look at things like businesses and their business pages getting directions, etc. I have been using it as my main browser on my computer and then woke up today unable to use it because they no longer support macOS 12.5 and my computer is so old that I can’t update it past what it is now. I understand that I don’t know what goes into developing and maintaining an app that can be used by multiple different operating system versions, but it is frustrating as a consumer to try to use programs that are designed to be “environmentally friendly” but not be able to… because I’m trying to be environmentally friendly and not throw away a usable computer. Just… a little ironic.

reviews.title: Can’t get a search. Developer/ecosia non responsive about it.
reviews.text: Three days ago I got the cloud fare “we’ve detected unusual activity, verify you’re not a robot” page.  I have no problem doing this. But now I can’t get into anything.  I can’t get past the cloud fare page. It just keeps on cycling through the verification page. I’ve reported the issue 4 times, there has  been no response and I still can’t get into it. I guess I’m just going to delete the app since obviously there’s no technical help available.  I am very very very disappointed. While this app wasn’t perfect, the fact it wasn’t google was huge but I have reported the problem 4 times. Twice on the ecosia homepage and twice on the App Store page and nobody has gotten back to me with any kind of suggestions or fixes. I did delete the app and re-dl it but the issue is still there. I am running the current version. Guess I’ll be looking for another do-good, non-google browser. Bummer.

reviews.title: AI Slop
reviews.text: This has been my default web browser for many years on my phone because of the environmental impact, but also because of how easy it was to use. I was devastated when I started seeing an AI summary at the top of my search results. I can’t stand the AI nonsense that these search engines spew at you, not to mention the hypocrisy of being a web browser that supposedly benefits the environment and then counteracting all of that by adding AI features, features that seem to be unpopular with the user base anyway based off other reviews. I did find that I could turn off the AI summary, so that was at least helpful. However, the last straw for me was that every time I googled something, the first 2-3 pages of results would be full AI generated blog posts before I got close to anything remotely human. I asked other people in my life who use different browsers if they were having this issue, and they weren’t. I tested other browsers on my phone and lo and behold, the amount of AI generated websites that popped up were drastically decreased. I am not a negative person who complains a lot. I am pretty sure this is the first publicly available negative review I have ever made in my entire life, but I cannot stand the hypocrisy. I expect this type of stuff from huge companies, not from apps like this. I am going to immediately delete this browser and use other options, which makes me really sad but I can’t take it anymore.
